summary: Gasa district is dominated by high‑altitude, glaciated landscapes, with Snow and Glacier covering 852.81 km² (27.2 %) and Alpine Scrubs covering 795.88 km² (25.4 %). Rocky Outcrops (556.85 km², 17.8 %) and Forests (555.71 km², 17.7 %) also represent significant portions, while the remaining land uses—Meadows, Moraines, Shrubs, Water Bodies, and minor agricultural and built‑up areas—together account for less than 10 % of the district.
